query: What is Canva's most recently reported number of monthly active users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Canva’s most recently reported monthly active users were “more than 265 million” for 2025, as reported by TechCrunch based on Canva’s statement about end-of-2025 results [1]. Canva’s most recently reported full-time employees figure available in the provided sources is not directly stated; the only employee-related disclosure is that a November 4, 2026 restructuring affected 1,271 people (about 22% of the workforce) without disclosing total headcount [2].
